name: app-gradient-text-thanks-with-memoji-closing-slide
title: Gradient Thanks with Memoji
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with a faint grid, a cartoon avatar giving a thumbs-up, big rounded 'Thanks for taking the time!' in a blue-to-violet gradient and a small line 'Waiting for your feedback'.
whatItMeans: The gradient headline and friendly avatar make the sign-off warm and personal, and the feedback line invites conversation.
techniques: Gradient fill running across the headline
Faint grid backdrop for subtle structure
Centred stack of image, headline, small line

vocabulary.definition: Lettering filled with a colour gradient.
A cartoon or memoji version of the author.
A closing line asking for responses.
